flow:
Create a precise high fidelity interaction storyboard for an actual SOLVABLE ABOUT PUZZLE on Omkar's portfolio. 4 sequential large frames in landscape 2x2 board. Design warm ivory, deep plum text, muted violet/apricot accents, friendly sans. Shared header tiny scribbled cat left, About Journey Projects Now Contact text nav right. THIS IS NOT AUTO-REVEAL ON SCROLL. User must fit pieces, then completed board rotates to show portrait, then four interest entrances appear. Use reference image as EXACT completed backside jacket portrait, preserve likeness and jacket; no new face or backdrop.
Frame1 LIGHT '01 / SOLVE': title 'A few pieces of me.' A six-piece physical jigsaw board with interlocking edges, 4 pieces fitted, 2 loose pieces in tray. The front design is typography on warm ivory: pieces of the about paragraph 'I’m Omkar. I like understanding how things fit together. Work is one part of the picture. There’s more beyond it.' Do NOT show portrait yet. Tiny instructions 'Drag a piece into place. Or select a piece, then its slot.' Label '4 of 6 pieces placed'. All 4 interests HIDDEN in this frame.
Frame2 LIGHT '02 / COMPLETE': same board all six pieces fitted and paragraph coherent, thin subtle seams, label 'All pieces fit.' No portrait, no interest sections. Outside arrow caption 'Completion triggers the flip once'.
Frame3 DARK '03 / FLIP': same single rectangular board rotating on vertical axis at 45 degrees, text face receding, jacket portrait backside beginning to face viewer. No interest sections yet. Outside caption 'One 180° flip · reduced motion uses a crossfade'.
Frame4 DARK '04 / EXPLORE': jacket portrait fully front facing as one clean image in rectangular board. Beneath it FOUR clearly labeled new actions 'Music & dance', 'Cars', 'Sports', 'Stories'. Caption 'The four interests appear after the reveal'. Include a small mobile inset within frame4 showing stacked complete portrait and 2x2 interest buttons, legible. Outside small bottom note 'Puzzle state persists during navigation. Touch and keyboard placement supported.' Do not show a fake actual game screenshot; this is concept UI with consistent pieces. Do not include automatic reading-trigger reveal. No countdown, score, leaderboard, forced replay, or fake personal claims. Make flow obvious and worded accurately. Preserve generous spacing and readable captions.
boardEdits: Edit ONLY the About frame (third numbered frame 03) in this storyboard. Keep Entrance with Omkar and cat, Landing and Music EXACTLY unchanged. In About replace the auto-assembling jacket portrait and paragraph layout with an ACTUAL six-piece jigsaw that the visitor solves: title 'A few pieces of me.'; six interlocking ivory puzzle slots with purple outlines, four fitted and two loose in a tray. Puzzle face carries short fragments of 'I’m Omkar. Work is one part of the picture. There’s more beyond it.' Do not show jacket portrait in this initial state. Do not show the four interest links or Continue button yet. Small instruction 'Fit the pieces to see the full picture.' and 'Drag, or tap a piece and its slot.' Label '4 / 6 placed'. Caption outside About frame 'Solve → flip → portrait → four interests'. Keep original palette and readable typography. This is a puzzle to be solved, not scroll-triggered image assembly. Other three frames must be preserved.
correction: Fix ONLY the words on puzzle pieces in frames01 and02 so they represent the SAME solvable six-piece puzzle with positions unchanged between states. Layout is 3 columns x2 rows. Exact labels row1 left 'I’m Omkar.', middle 'I like understanding', right 'how things fit together.' Row2 left 'Work is one part', middle 'of the picture.', right 'There’s more beyond it.' In frame01 have FOUR placed pieces at top-left, top-middle, bottom-left, bottom-middle with those exact labels. Top-right and bottom-right slots EMPTY. The two loose pieces are labeled 'how things fit together.' and 'There’s more beyond it.' respectively, matching their correct slots. In frame02 all six pieces fitted at their fixed correct positions with exact labels above. No duplicate or missing phrases. Keep all other visuals, frames03/04, portrait, colors and captions unchanged.
